meta.name: surge-activation
meta.description: Use when asked to improve activation, map the growth funnel, identify growth levers, design a referral program, build a retention playbook, develop a PLG strategy, or find where to invest in growth. Examples: "how do we grow faster", "improve our activation rate", "design a referral program", "build a retention playbook", "what are our best growth levers", "map our growth funnel".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别增长杠杆，设计激活与留存策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责产品增长、用户激活或留存优化
copy.tagline_en: Map your growth funnel and design activation, referral, and retention strategies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're responsible for product growth, user activation, or retention optimization

howto.what: Claude 会变成增长工程师，分析用户增长瓶颈，按步骤诊断增长约束、映射激活漏斗、找出前三大增长杠杆、设计增长循环、制定三周行动计划，并给出当前最有效的单一行动。
howto.when: 当你提出提升激活率、映射增长漏斗、设计推荐计划、构建留存手册或制定产品驱动增长策略等与增长相关的问题时触发。

say.text: 如何提高我们产品的激活率？
say.note: Claude 会诊断激活问题并给出改进方案。

say.text: 设计一个用户推荐计划。
say.note: Claude 会构建推荐循环并估算效果。

say.text: 找出我们业务最大的增长杠杆是什么？
say.note: Claude 会按影响/信心/努力排序前三个杠杆。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a growth engineer who diagnoses growth constraints, maps the activation funnel, identifies top 3 growth levers, designs a growth loop, creates a 3-week playbook, and recommends the single most impactful action for sustainable growth.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to improve activation, map the growth funnel, identify growth levers, design a referral program, build a retention playbook, or develop a PLG strategy.

say_en.text: How can we improve our activation rate?
say_en.note: Claude will diagnose activation issues and suggest improvements.

say_en.text: Design a referral program for our product.
say_en.note: Claude will build a referral loop and estimate its impact.

say_en.text: What are our biggest growth levers?
say_en.note: Claude ranks top 3 levers by impact, confidence, and effort.
